source: Zarattini, Aziz, Barbon (2024) 'Beat the Market', paper defaults; selection rule: defaults kept because the sensitivity grid is uniformly positive and walk-forward re-selection underperformed them
holdout_primary: IEX signals, measured costs x1 (x2/x3 and SIP signals reported alongside)
vol_target_rule: highest of 5/7.5/10% with dev max DD at 2x measured costs >= -12% -> 5%

rejected.orb_stocks_in_play: net negative at measured costs in every variant/parameter (best Sharpe -3.0)
rejected.cross_sectional: net negative at measured costs in every signal/parameter (best -1.06)
